Baseline has two list-all argv sites, a local checker that accepts bare arrays and incomplete count/read-output evidence, dev host 2026.8.15, peer/manifest floor 2026.8.15, no packed host matrix, unbounded controls absent from package/workflow changelog reads, and configured coverage thresholds 68/85/74 rather than 100/100/100/100.

Partial or compacted tracker reads can make upsert create duplicates or export omit tasks while appearing successful; deprecated diagnostics and stale host assumptions make agent automation noisy and brittle.
